audits.observations: Root ordered second reading: whole and both actual supplied halves viewed before image-first receipt and text opening; all26 fresh audit crops personally viewed. Every agreed/differing word, source hyphen, accent, mathematical alphabet, object, index, arrow, label, underline, cancellation and addition was compared with the ink. Four enclosure details and the open irregular marginal outline are corrected; four arrow-label sides are corrected using the observed positions and installed TikZ label-side rules. Both opéra- line divisions are preserved. The cancelled Hom has previously omitted relation traces, retained with doubt. The replacement abbreviation compar and open-hook digit4 are resolved from the fresh crops; the heavily cancelled earlier reference is broadened to explicit alternatives and stays low-confidence. Soient G, the A-shaped CM1 objects and A(theta), the typed/handwritten mixture, all four diagram directions and single-wave isomorphism marks remain as written. Manuscript14 and archival45 remain distinct. No context or mathematical proof check was used.
